question: Refer to the exhibit. Which backup operation type does not include the Preserve Identities feature?
context:
UCS Manager GUI: Create Backup Operation dialog.
Admin State: Enabled / Disabled
Type: Full State / All Configuration / System Configuration / Logical Configuration
Preserve Identities: checkbox
theory: 'Preserve Identities' is a checkbox available for the XML-based backup types (All Configuration, System Configuration, Logical Configuration) that lets you retain pool-derived identities (MAC, UUID, WWN, etc.) when the file is later imported, since those XML exports would otherwise regenerate new identities from the pools on import. A Full State backup is a complete binary snapshot of the whole system, including all runtime identity assignments already embedded in it and restorable only to a fabric interconnect of the same software version — there is nothing extra to 'preserve' via a separate option, so this feature does not apply to it. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Configuration Management, Backup Operations)
